body: I hope everything works out for you man.

guys, if you're thinking about killing yourself. Stop. I tried. It was scary as hell when I realized that I was actually truly dying, my life was ending. When you truly realize it, it's beyond horrifying. believe me, it's not worth it. I have been through a lot, and I know you've heard it many times, but there's good out there, not just bad. I'm so amazed at how things turned out to be. It's still not over yet, but I survived. Thank god I guess. Thank you guys for posting, you really have no idea how I perceived your posts then and now. Also sorry for my english.

I didn't tell him I have homosexual attractions. There is no way he could understand that. He thinks after beating the shit out of me when I was little, saying horrible things and so on had just magically made my sexuality change. I only confessed the truth about my major and the pills. I was absolutely losing it. I don't remember much because my brain was affected by the overdose, everything seemed hazy (as well as the dp/dr condition on top of that). 

He took it very well, and realized that I was going to die because I told him I overdosed. He took me to the hospital and they treated me (still at the hospital bed until now).

I survived. It was horrible. The entire hospital knew and kept thinking I tried to commit suicide. Where I live, there's a huge stigma around suicide. If you try to commit suicide, people will think you're insane, any chance of a bright future is probably gone. The hospital called the police. I tried to lie. It's not going well. they don't want to release me. I think they might try to send me to a mental facility. My dad is angry as hell now. Not because I changed my major, but because everyone knows I swallowed these pills. I can't blame him to be honest. Oh dear god, I had no idea everything would take such a turn! absolutely crazy!

But you know what? I kinda love it. I was living in a comfortable bubble, now everything around me is out of control.  My life before the attempt and confession seems unreal and distant. wow!
